environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS ECS behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) configured with HTTP/1.1 listeners on port 443 with standard TLS termination. ALB target group uses HTTP/1.1 to forward to PHP-FPM containers running on port 8080. No request validation rules on the ALB. The internal-service.local resolves to a sidecar container in the same task definition that also processes the /internal/admin route.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM certificate, default action forward to target group
config.network: awsvpc mode, security group allows all inbound from ALB SG
